Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the controlled variable by choosing the independent variable (amount of air) to keep constant. The question asks what should be kept the same across balls when testing air amount’s effect on bounce height; the correct control is the drop distance. The Planner confused within-ball trial consistency with across-ball controls, leading to the wrong choice (A instead of B).
